personal.title: Consistent transition, professional maturity, and focus on results
content: With over 6 years of corporate experience at Editora Construir, I made a structured transition into technology, combining business acumen with software engineering to solve practical problems.

Graduated in Systems Analysis and Development (Wyden) and currently pursuing MBAs in Software Engineering and Cybersecurity (FAMEF). Experienced in modern web development (React, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS) and Python automation routines.
Led a volunteer development squad at Skill Labs and built automations that reduced manual task time by over 80% at Editora Construir, prioritizing clean code, stability, and direct team impact.

Services.title: What I Bring to the Table

service1.title: Web Development (React & Next.js)
service1.description: Building modern, responsive, high-performance, and accessible web applications using React 19, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

service2.title: RESTful APIs & Databases
service2.description: Architecting clean, scalable Node.js APIs using Fastify or NestJS (Clean Architecture), database modeling with Prisma and PostgreSQL in Docker.

service3.title: Process Automation & RPA in Python
service3.description: Developing intelligent bots, batch document processing pipelines (PDFs and spreadsheets), and scrapers to eliminate repetitive manual workflows.

Contact.headline: Looking for a mature, proactive Junior Developer with consistent delivery?
Contact.desc1: I am open to opportunities as a Junior Full Stack, Front-end, or Back-end Developer, both remotely and on-site/hybrid in João Pessoa (PB), Brazil.
Contact.desc2: I bring established corporate maturity, a completed tech degree, ongoing post-graduate specializations, and a strong drive to learn and apply modern technologies.
Contact.desc3: If your team needs someone dependable, focused on solving real-world challenges, and ready to contribute from sprint one, I would love to connect!
Contact.invitation: Feel free to reach out via email or WhatsApp:

Skills.Frontend: Front-end: React 19, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, Zustand
Skills.Backend: Back-end: Node.js, NestJS, Fastify, RESTful APIs, WebSockets
Skills.Automation: Automation & RPA: Python, Pandas, Regex, BeautifulSoup, Playwright
Skills.DatabaseDevOps: Databases & DevOps: PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, Docker, Git, CI/CD

Projects.Aparatus: Full-stack web platform built with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind v4, and Prisma 7 with PostgreSQL. Features modern authentication (better-auth), responsive analytics dashboard, and modular architecture.
Projects.FSWDonalds: Full-stack self-service restaurant ordering system built with Next.js 15, React 19, Server Actions, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and Radix UI. Fluid, interactive mobile-first user experience.
Projects.Gam3rStoreBackend: Enterprise RESTful e-commerce API built with NestJS and TypeScript following Clean Architecture and SOLID principles. Features authentication, PostgreSQL via Prisma, Docker containerization, and automated tests (Jest & Supertest E2E).
Projects.NLWExpertPolls: Real-time voting system built with Node.js, Fastify, and WebSockets. Uses Redis Pub/Sub for instant score propagation, PostgreSQL for persistence, and strict runtime validation with Zod.
Projects.PricePulseAI: Intelligent multi-agent orchestrator in Python using the Model Context Protocol (MCP), CustomTkinter desktop UI, and PostgreSQL. Monitors price fluctuations and triggers automated analysis.
Projects.CommercialFlowBot: Python RPA for automated screening and structured data extraction from hundreds of PDF documents using Regex. Reduced manual operational rework by over 80% at Editora Construir.
Projects.MapaStatus: High-performance Python RPA utilizing parallel processing (concurrent.futures) and Pandas to extract unstructured data from bulk PDF batches, consolidating management spreadsheets.
Projects.UploadWidgetWeb: Modern asynchronous file upload widget built with React 19, Vite, Tailwind v4, Zustand 5, and Radix UI. Features reactive state management, upload queues, and complete accessibility.
Projects.ContactCollectorScraper: Automated web scraping and prospecting tool built in Python (BeautifulSoup & Requests). Extracts educational contact databases in batches and sanitizes data via regular expressions.
Projects.AssistantListFlow: Python automation tool for converting PDF documents to images and generating metadata, accelerating batch integration for legacy management systems.
Projects.EducFormBot: Intelligent Python automation focused on batch PDF generation and precise form filling. Reduced document issuing from hours to seconds with zero error rate.
Projects.ScanFlowBot: Python automation script designed to audit file systems, analyze chronological metadata, and generate status reports on digitized documents.
Projects.NLWExpertNotes: React web note-taking app featuring real-time speech-to-text transcription via Web Speech API, instant search, and a modern UI styled with Tailwind CSS.
